runbook: R-18 / R-19 (independent oracle; evidence tree = git archive HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md only)

independent_computation.step_1_identify_the_effect: The scenario name pairs two items. Of the two, only Bloodsong (id 3877, shop tag SUPPORT, buildsFrom 3867, classic sr 5v5 = true) is a support item, so an entry in `support_events` for this roster is a Bloodsong event. Bloodsong carries exactly one numeric combat effect that is 'applied' to a target: the Spellblade passive's 'Expose Weakness' debuff. Black Cleaver (id 3071) is tagged TANK/legendary and is not a support item; its Carve is armor reduction, not an applied support amount.
independent_computation.step_2_read_the_cached_source: data/items.json -> '3877'.passives[0] (name 'Spellblade').branches[0]: "After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack)." The amp magnitude is therefore the wiki template {{rd|8%|5%}}.
independent_computation.step_3_resolve_the_rd_template: The League Wiki {{rd|A|B}} template is 'melee value | ranged value' (A = melee, B = ranged). Corroborated three ways inside the same cached corpus: (a) Doran's Shield (id 1054) writes {{rd|0 to 5 for 11|0 to 3.75 for 11|...|formula1=0.066 health regen per 1% missing health|formula2=0.05 ...}} and its own prose then says AoE/DoT/proc damage 'trigger this effect with the {{tip|ranged}} values' -> the SECOND argument is the ranged one; (b) Blade of the Ruined King (id 3153) {{rd|9%|6%}} current health on-hit = the known live melee 9% / ranged 6%; (c) Death's Dance (id 6333) {{rd|30%|10%}} = the known live melee 30% / ranged 10%.
independent_computation.step_4_compute: applied_amount is a unit fraction (the golden stores 0.08, not 8). Expose Weakness amp = 8% -> 8/100 = 0.08 for a melee wielder (5% -> 0.05 for a ranged wielder). The new golden value 0.08 is exactly the melee branch of the cached source.
independent_computation.step_5_falsify_the_old_value: 0.3 (=30%) does not appear anywhere in Bloodsong's cached entry: its passives/active branches contain only 100% base AD, 4 s duration, 1.5 s cooldown, 10 s window, and {{rd|8%|5%}}; its stats are 200 health, 75% base health regen, 75% base mana regen, 9 gold/10. 30% IS, however, exactly the co-equipped Black Cleaver's cap: data/items.json '3071'.passives[0] ('Carve'): "Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks." So 0.3 in a Bloodsong support event is the Black Cleaver Carve cap (0.06 x 5 = 0.30) surfacing on the wrong effect / a stale constant, not a sourced Bloodsong number. Under no reading of the cached Bloodsong text is 0.3 defensible.
independent_computation.arithmetic: melee: 8% = 0.08 (matches new value). ranged: 5% = 0.05. Black Cleaver cap (the old value's likely origin): 6% x 5 stacks = 30% = 0.30.

Terminus/BC ramps (`average_pen`, `average_reduction`) | Cesaro mean of the per-hit ramp | APPROX | ... BC constant = exact mean at ~10 autos ... — i.e. the engine models Black Cleaver as a ramped/averaged armor reduction, so a flat 0.30 is not even the Black Cleaver figure the engine is entitled to emit, let alone a Bloodsong support amount.

caveat: The evidence tree deliberately excludes src/, tests/, scripts/ and the scenario definition, so the roster's Bloodsong holder attack type could not be observed. The cached source admits exactly two legal values for this leaf: 0.08 (melee wielder) and 0.05 (ranged wielder). The new value lands exactly on the melee branch, which is the consistent reading for a Black-Cleaver-carrying (melee bruiser) build. Should the Bloodsong holder in this roster in fact be a ranged champion, the correct value would be 0.05 and the verdict would become 'both_wrong'; in either case the old value 0.3 is unsourced and wrong.
